answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 37949 Country: India Title: My mom mostly saw a dream that she is in a big house and try to close most of the door and feeling fear Question: My mom mostly saw a dream that she is in a big house and try to close most of the door and feeling fear. Answer ID: 37949 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 578/489/B=1433) It indicates towards the shortcomings of good deeds in your mother. Ask her to practice all the fardh, wajib and sunnah acts regularly and not to show miserliness towards the hospitality of guests. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
